name: io.github.Nomad07/nftdata-mcp
description: OpenSea NFT collection market data (floor, volume, sales, owners, supply) via the NFT Data API, paid per call with x402.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet holding a small amount of USDC on Base. Pays $0.002 per request via x402.

environmentVariables.name: NFTDATA_MAX_REQUESTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum signed payments per session (integer 1-1000, default 100).
